newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.07 down at 41.35 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday amid higher demand of the U.S. currency by traders, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open lower on Friday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 3.00 percent, compared to the opening at 2.80 percent.
